description: Erection of a hip to gable rear roof extension with Juliet balcony and two front roof windows. Erection of a single storey rear extension, and detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P001, P002, P003, P004, P005, Received: 26/04/2021, P007, P008, Received: 25/05/2021, P006, Received: 23/06/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The hereby approved outbuilding shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the main house at 21 Hogarth Gardens, TW5 0QS and for no other purpose and it shall not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes.
